title: C2DTA Smart Ring (simulated wearable)
description: Simulated smart ring publishing skin temperature and SpO2 telemetry at 0.2 msg/s nominal over MQTT with TLS (QoS 1). Payloads conform to the JSON Schema https://c2dta.org/egw/schemas/smart-ring-v1.schema.json (envelope + measurement fields, CONTRACTS.md sections 2-3). The placeholder {{EGW_HOST}} is substituted at deployment time with the broker host (env EGW_MQTT_HOST); {egw_id} and {device_uuid} are URI variables declared in uriVariables. The Ditto twin of a device instance is org.c2dta:{device_uuid} (CONTRACTS.md section 4).

basic_sc.description: MQTT username/password over TLS (Mosquitto password_file; anonymous access forbidden; CONTRACTS.md section 1).

egw_id.description: Edge gateway identifier (env EGW_ID, default egw-01; CONTRACTS.md section 2).

device_uuid.description: Stable UUID v4 of the simulated device instance (CONTRACTS.md section 2).

spo2_pct.title: Blood oxygen saturation (SpO2)
spo2_pct.description: Peripheral oxygen saturation as an integer percentage.

telemetry.title: Telemetry event
telemetry.description: Complete telemetry payload (common envelope + skin_temp_c, spo2_pct) published by the device with MQTT QoS 1 on topic c2dt/{egw_id}/{device_uuid}/telemetry. Validated by the controller against the JSON Schema referenced in links (rel schema) before any Ditto update.

data.description: JSON object conforming to https://c2dta.org/egw/schemas/smart-ring-v1.schema.json (draft 2020-12, unevaluatedProperties false).
